title: REQ-SYNC-013 uses non-EARS format (THE SYSTEM SHALL without trigger clause)
description: REQ-SYNC-013 (behavioral-spec.md lines 187-190) uses a bare 'THE SYSTEM SHALL' pattern without a WHEN/WHERE/IF trigger: 'THE SYSTEM SHALL return: 200 for all processed/ignored/failed events...' This is technically a 'Ubiquitous' EARS pattern (always applies), but the spec does not label it as such. More importantly, the '200 for all processed/ignored/failed events' is not truly ubiquitous — it is conditioned on the webhook endpoint being invoked. A proper EARS formulation would be: 'WHEN POST /v1/payjp/webhook is received AND token verification passes THE SYSTEM SHALL return 200 for processed/ignored/failed events.'
recommendation: Reformulate REQ-SYNC-013 using proper EARS trigger: 'WHEN POST /v1/payjp/webhook is received THE SYSTEM SHALL return...' to clarify the scope. Similar issue exists in REQ-SYNC-015 (line 202).
